overlays.reason: PINNED SUPERSET shadow (removeWhenPublished=false). The on-network copy has caught up on the join-link preview defs, so the only remaining local addition is groupPublicView, which upstream main deleted alongside chat.bsky.group.getGroupPublicInfo even though both remain published on-network and chat.bsky.group.getGroupPublicInfo (listed in generator/lexicons.json) refs chat.bsky.group.defs#groupPublicView. Retiring or re-vendoring from main would drop the GroupPublicView symbols from models.api. With expectDrift=true, the detector stays quiet while this entry reads DRIFTED against upstream main — that is the point of the flag, not a gap. It only speaks up if the entry becomes REDUNDANT (network copy matches vendored) or reads in-sync with upstream (upstream re-added groupPublicView). Re-vendoring or retiring is therefore a MANUAL periodic check, not something the weekly workflow will prompt.
overlays.driftReason: Re-adds groupPublicView, which upstream main deleted but which is still published on-network and reffed by chat.bsky.group.getGroupPublicInfo.

overlays.reason: Preserved after upstream deletion both on GitHub and from on-network PLC DID repo. Retiring it would remove getGroupPublicInfo and break binary/source compatibility.
overlays.driftReason: Upstream removed getGroupPublicInfo in favor of getJoinLinkPreviews; vendored to retain API backwards compatibility.

overlays.reason: Vendored for the thread V2 item types (threadItemPost and its siblings, including opThreadPostIndex / opThreadPostCount). app.bsky.unspecced.* has no on-network lexicon authority (`_lexicon.unspecced.bsky.app` does not resolve), so `lex install` cannot fetch it. The rest of the namespace stays out of scope; the file is vendored whole so the staleness detector can compare it byte-for-byte with upstream.

The thread read the official Bluesky client ships on: a flat, server-ordered list with OP-thread numbering. Not resolvable on-network (see app.bsky.unspecced.defs). Upstream marks it experimental; re-vendor when the staleness detector reports drift.
Companion to getPostThreadV2: returns the replies the main call leaves out (muted, hidden by threadgate). Not resolvable on-network (see app.bsky.unspecced.defs).
